page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-2x.8xlarge is an accelerated compute instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family, virtualized on KVM. The system is equipped with 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Memory capacity totals 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPUs offering an aggregate total of 48 GB of GPU VRAM.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 32 Gbps. The instance contains no bundled local storage, meaning operating systems and persistence layers require external cloud block storage attachments. From a hardware resource perspective, the instance provides cost efficiency for multi-threaded and GPU-accelerated computing by pairing high-frequency dedicated Intel cores and ample system RAM with dual modern graphics accelerators, bypassing the cost of full-scale enterprise clustering. However, storage I/O performance is dependent on external network storage throughput rather than local NVMe drives.

With its dual Ada Lovelace accelerators, 48 GB total video memory, 32 dedicated cores, and high memory ratio, this server type is configured for machine learning inference, computer vision processing, video transcoding, 3D rendering, and accelerated scientific data analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, and is paired with two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs delivering a total of 48 GB VRAM. Virtualized on KVM, the configuration includes a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile but provides no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for system and data disks. The platform provides strong qualitative compute efficiency for accelerated processing by combining dedicated high-clock Intel cores with dual modern GPUs. This architecture is well suited for machine learning inference, computer vision pipelines, multi-stream video transcoding, 3D graphics rendering, and memory-intensive accelerated data analytics workloads.
